set.body: From S9.1 (p0-s91). Rebind is an in-place, undoable BindFigure. The inspector copy says 'Rebinding makes a new figure version; the old one stays reproducible', but no figure version is persisted; only undo history and S2.6 retention keep the old run reachable. Decide: persist figure versions (document schema change), or reword the copy. Related: 'Keep as rev 3' stays session-only, per the S2.2 decision that keeping a stale figure is not a command.
set.title: Persisted figure versions on rebind (inspector copy promises 'old version stays reproducible')
